name: Zina
overview: Zina is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified as a descendant of Shimei. His lineage is noted specifically in 1 Chronicles 23:10, establishing his place within the Levitical family. Beyond his tribal affiliation and descent, Scripture provides no additional personal details about him.
namesAndTitles: The individual is known primarily by the name Zina, which is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 23:10. Another form of his name, Zizah, appears in 1 Chronicles 23:11 and is understood as a childish abbreviation or term of endearment, similar to 'mama.' Neither name is indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Zina is a descendant of Shimei, linking him to a specific Levitical lineage. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zina's significance lies in his place within the Levitical genealogies, which were important for organizing the priestly duties and temple service in Israel. His mention as a descendant of Shimei situates him within the broader framework of God's covenant people, emphasizing the continuity of Levitical service. While not a central figure in narrative events, his inclusion in the genealogical records underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His chosen tribe through successive generations.
